name: The House of the Rising Sun

info.album: The Animals: All-Time Greatest Hits (Rerecorded Version)

podcast.body: This song, described as the group's first single, achieved significant chart success, reaching number 21 initially and later number 1 in both the UK and US. Its arrangement was largely based on a radically reworked B-side by Hogi Land, which itself adapted Bob Dylan's version. The Animals' rendition featured a distinctive arpeggiated guitar part by Hilton Valentine and a breakdown section with spoken lyrics over staccato backing, along with a Burt Berns-style call and response ending. "which made number 21."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 115: "House of the Rising Sun" by the Animals

podcast.body: While a number 1 hit in both the UK and US, the single version released in the US was severely cut down to 3 minutes with "brutal edits," particularly to the organ solo, which none of the group approved of. The proper, unedited version was subsequently released as an album track everywhere. "All of the version released as a single in the US was cut down to 3 minutes, with some brutal edits, particularly to the organ solo."
